name: Lay On Hands
description: You have a pool of healing power equal to five times your Paladin level, which refills when you finish a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which can be yourself) and restore any number of Hit Points from the pool. You can also spend 5 points from the pool to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don't also restore Hit Points.

name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Paladin spells using Charisma. You prepare spells from the Paladin list and can replace one of them when you finish a Long Rest. You can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: You can use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice that you are proficient with. After a Long Rest you can change those choices.

name: Fighting Style
description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. If you prefer, you can take Blessed Warrior instead: you learn two Cleric cantrips (Guidance and Sacred Flame are suggested), which count as Paladin spells and use Charisma. You can replace one of them when you gain a Paladin level.

name: Paladin's Smite
description: You always have Divine Smite prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, regaining that use when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Channel Divinity
description:
You can channel divine energy 2 times, regaining one use on a Short Rest and all uses on a Long Rest. You have 3 uses at level 11. You start with one effect:
Divine Sense: as a Bonus Action, you open your awareness for 10 minutes or until you are Incapacitated. You know the location and creature type of every Celestial, Fiend, and Undead within 60 feet, and you sense any place or object in that range that has been consecrated or desecrated, as with the Hallow spell.

name: Paladin Subclass
description: You choose a subclass: Oath of Devotion, Oath of Glory, Oath of the Ancients, or Oath of Vengeance. You gain its features at levels 3, 7, 15, and 20.

name: Ability Score Improvement
description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for. You gain this again at levels 8, 12, and 16.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, not once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Faithful Steed
description: You always have Find Steed prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, regaining that use when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Aura of Protection
description: You radiate a protective aura in a 10-foot Emanation, which is inactive while you are Incapacitated. You and your allies in the aura add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to saving throws. A creature can benefit from only one Paladin's aura at a time.

name: Abjure Foes
description: As a Magic action, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity and target a number of creatures you can see within 60 feet, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Each must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened for 1 minute or until it takes damage. While Frightened this way, a creature can do only one of these on its turn: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action.

name: Aura of Courage
description: You and your allies are immune to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Frightened ally enters the aura, the condition has no effect on them while they stay there.

name: Radiant Strikes
description: When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, it takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

name: Restoring Touch
description: When you use Lay On Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of these conditions from it: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned. Each condition removed costs 5 points from the pool, and those points don't also restore Hit Points.

name: Aura Expansion
description: Your Aura of Protection becomes a 30-foot Emanation.

name: Epic Boon
description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Truesight is the suggested choice.

name: Oath of Devotion Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Paladin level. Level 3: Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith. Level 5: Aid, Zone of Truth. Level 9: Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic. Level 13: Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith. Level 17: Commune, Flame Strike.

name: Sacred Weapon
description: When you take the Attack action, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon you are holding for 10 minutes or until you use this feature again. You add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attack rolls with it, and each hit can deal the weapon's normal damage type or Radiant damage. The weapon sheds Bright Light for 20 feet and Dim Light for 20 feet beyond. You can end the effect early (no action required), and it ends if you stop carrying the weapon.

name: Aura of Devotion
description: You and your allies are immune to the Charmed condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, the condition has no effect on them while they stay there.

name: Smite of Protection
description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and your allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection. This lasts until the start of your next turn.

name: Holy Nimbus
description:
As a Bonus Action, you fill your Aura of Protection with holy power for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). While it lasts:
Holy Ward: you have Advantage on saving throws that a Fiend or an Undead forces you to make.
Radiant Damage: an enemy that starts its turn in the aura takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus.
Sunlight: the aura is filled with Bright Light that is sunlight.

name: Inspiring Smite
description: Right after you cast Divine Smite, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity to hand out Temporary Hit Points to creatures of your choice within 30 feet, which can include you. The total is 2d8 plus your Paladin level, divided as you choose.

name: Oath of Glory Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Paladin level. Level 3: Guiding Bolt, Heroism. Level 5: Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon. Level 9: Haste, Protection from Energy. Level 13: Compulsion, Freedom of Movement. Level 17: Legend Lore, Yolande's Regal Presence.

name: Peerless Athlete
description: As a Bonus Action, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity to boost your athleticism for 1 hour. You have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and your Long Jump and High Jump distances increase by 10 feet. The extra distance still costs movement.

name: Aura of Alacrity
description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Also, an ally who enters your Aura of Protection for the first time on a turn, or starts their turn there, has their Speed increased by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

name: Glorious Defense
description: When you or another creature you can see within 10 feet is hit by an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to the target's Armor Class against that attack, possibly causing a miss. If it misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of the same Reaction, if the attacker is within your weapon's range. You have a number of uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and regain them on a Long Rest.

name: Living Legend
description:
As a Bonus Action, you take on the power of the legends for 10 minutes. You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). While it lasts:
Charismatic: you have Advantage on all Charisma checks.
Saving Throw Reroll: if you fail a saving throw, you can use your Reaction to reroll it. You must use the new roll.
Unerring Strike: once on each of your turns, when you miss with a weapon attack roll, you can make it hit instead.

name: Nature's Wrath
description: As a Magic action, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity to call up spectral vines. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be Restrained for 1 minute. A Restrained creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Paladin level. Level 3: Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals. Level 5: Misty Step, Moonbeam. Level 9: Plant Growth, Protection from Energy. Level 13: Ice Storm, Stoneskin. Level 17: Commune with Nature, Tree Stride.

name: Aura of Warding
description: You and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage while in your Aura of Protection.

name: Undying Sentinel
description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points and not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead and regain Hit Points equal to three times your Paladin level. You can do this once per Long Rest. Also, you can't be aged magically, and you stop visibly aging.

name: Elder Champion
description:
As a Bonus Action, you fill your Aura of Protection with primal power for 1 minute. You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). While it lasts:
Diminish Defiance: enemies in the aura have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and Channel Divinity options.
Regeneration: at the start of each of your turns, you regain 10 Hit Points.
Swift Spells: when you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can cast it as a Bonus Action instead.

name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
description: You always have these spells prepared once you reach the listed Paladin level. Level 3: Bane, Hunter's Mark. Level 5: Hold Person, Misty Step. Level 9: Haste, Protection from Energy. Level 13: Banishment, Dimension Door. Level 17: Hold Monster, Scrying.

name: Vow of Enmity
description: When you take the Attack action, you can spend a use of Channel Divinity to swear a vow against a creature you can see within 30 feet. You have Advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until you use this feature again. If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you can move the vow to a different creature within 30 feet (no action required).

name: Relentless Avenger
description: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, you can reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn. You can then move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction, without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Soul of Vengeance
description: Right after a creature under your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to make a melee attack against it if it is within range.

name: Avenging Angel
description:
As a Bonus Action, you take on an angelic form for 10 minutes. You can do this once per Long Rest, or again by spending a level 5 spell slot (no action required). While it lasts:
Flight: wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet, and you can hover.
Frightful Aura: an enemy that starts its turn in your Aura of Protection must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened for 1 minute or until it takes damage. Attack rolls against the Frightened creature have Advantage.
